text:
The plate is a square plate of about 24 cm across the diagonal-ish side. The two corn cob pieces are roughly 5-6 cm in diameter, which is about 1/4 of the plate width.

The right piece is about 100 px wide against a plate about 380 px wide, so with a 24 cm plate it is roughly 6 cm across. The left piece is about 90 px, or about 5.5 cm. Each piece looks about 2-3 cm tall.

Weight of each piece, treating it as a cylinder with the cob included:
- Right piece: about 6 cm diameter and 2.5 cm tall gives a volume of about 70 cm³, so roughly 65 g.
- Left piece: about 5.5 cm diameter and 2.5 cm tall gives about 60 cm³, so roughly 55 g.

Corn on the cob, boiled, is about 95 kcal/100 g including the cob. Edible kernel is about 120 kcal/100 g, but the cob is heavy and inedible, so the blended value is lower. I'll use about 90.

Total is about 120 g, treated as one item.
